answer_1.quote: retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) involves using a retrieval system to supplement LLMs with relevant external information, thereby improving text generation quality.

answer_2.quote: For datasets annotated with long-form answers, we employ the Rouge Score (ROUGE) to evaluate the quality of the generated answers... For datasets with short answers, we use the Exact Match (EM) metric... we also report the proportion of instances where at least one short answer matches (Hit@1).
